mapper.select: SELECT BOOKID AS bookid, BOOKNAME AS bookname, ORGID AS orgid, ORGNAME AS orgname, ACCTIDZT AS acctid, BOOKDESC AS bookdesc, BOOKYEAR AS bookyear, BALANCESHEETURL AS balancesheeturl, INCOMESTATEMENTSURL AS incomestatementsurl, CASHFLOWSTATEMENTSURL AS cashflowstatementsurl FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ACCBOOK WHERE 1=1 AND acctid = #{acctid} AND bookyear = #{bookyear} AND orgid = #{orgid}
SELECT ZID, ACC1, ZC, QCS1, JSGS1, QMS1, JSGS2, ACC2, QY, QCS2, JSGS3, QMS2, JSGS4, LINENO1, LINENO2 FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_REPORT_YBAL ORDER BY zid
SELECT AYEAR AS ayear, STARTDATE AS startdate, ENDDATE AS enddate, IMPORT AS import_, VOUTBNAME AS voutbname, AMONTH AS amonth FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_PERIOD WHERE AYEAR = #{bookYear}

SELECT ITEM AS item, CURYEAR_BYS AS curyearBys, BYS_FORMULA AS bysFormula, CURYEAR_BNLJ AS curyearBnlj, BNLJ_FORMULA AS bnljFormula, ID AS id, MONTH1 AS month1, MONTH2 AS month2, MONTH3 AS month3, MONTH4 AS month4, MONTH5 AS month5, MONTH6 AS month6, MONTH7 AS month7, MONTH8 AS month8, MONTH9 AS month9, MONTH10 AS month10, MONTH11 AS month11, MONTH12 AS month12 FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_REPORT_MPROFIT order by ID asc
